en.title: Three-Character Substrings with Exactly Two Vowels
en.description:
Count the contiguous substrings of length exactly 3 that contain exactly two vowels; vowels are a, e, i, o, u, and substrings may overlap.

This site's standard input and output are explicit; ranges not given by the source problem are marked as this site's convention.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string of length 0..1000, which may be an empty line.
en.explanation: Example 1: elc has only 1 vowel, lco only 1, wel also only 1, and com also only 1; ome has 2, so the correct result is 1, and the original site's 2 is wrong. Example 2: there is no substring of length 3, so output 0. Example 3: the two ana windows each have two a's, so output 2.
hints: Maintain the vowel count of the last three characters; once the window length reaches 3, add one whenever the count is 2.
